international.title: International Subscription Terms & Conditions
international.scope: All International Packages & Users Outside Nepal
international.preamble: By completing an international subscription payment on DGO (app/web), you agree to be bound by these Terms & Conditions.

sections.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms & Purchases
sections.body: 1.1 Purchase Confirmation: All international purchases (app or web) are final upon payment verification. Subscribers are responsible for verifying package, duration, currency, price, content availability, and device compatibility prior to payment. 1.2 Instant Access: Subscription access begins immediately upon successful payment verification and transaction authorization. 1.3 Scope of Application: Governs all users residing outside Nepal or transactions processed via Stripe credit/debit cards or digital wallets.

sections.title: 2. Strict No Refund Policy
sections.body: 2.1 Absolute Non-Refundability: Because digital streaming content & service credentials are accessible immediately upon payment, ALL international subscription sales processed through the platform are STRICTLY NON-REFUNDABLE IN ALL CASES AND UNDER ALL CIRCUMSTANCES (no cash refunds, partial refunds, pro-rata credits, or billing adjustments for accidental purchases, wrong packages, duplicates, buyer's remorse, or non-usage).

sections.title: 3. Non-Refundable Scenarios & Buyer Responsibilities
sections.body: 3.1 Accidental / Duplicate Purchases: Wrong plan selection, multiple purchases by mistake, or user checkout error. 3.2 Buyer's Remorse: Changing mind post-purchase, content dissatisfaction, or deciding not to use the service. 3.3 Device & Network Incompatibility: Issues caused by network, ISP limits, VPN/Proxy interference, or unsupported hardware/browsers. 3.4 Geographical & Rights Restrictions: Inability to view specific titles due to territorial licensing outside Nepal. 3.5 Account Inactivity & Auto-Renewals: Failure to log in/use subscription, or failure to cancel auto-renewals prior to billing.

sections.title: 4. Chargebacks, Disputes & System Outages
sections.body: 4.1 Chargebacks & Account Suspension: Billing inquiries must be resolved with DGO Support. Unfounded credit card chargebacks/disputes filed via Stripe or issuing banks without prior consultation will trigger immediate and permanent account suspension across all devices.

sections.title: 5. Service Disruption & Technical maintenance
sections.body: 5.1 Platform Outages: In the event of major, continuous catastrophic platform failure >72 hours worldwide attributable to DGO, DGO may, at its sole discretion, issue prorated subscription time extensions (strictly no monetary refunds or cash-backs).

sections.title: 6. Customer Support, Audit Logs & Checkout Consent
sections.body: 6.1 Support Channel: Contact support via in-app chat or email at support@watchdgo.com for assistance. 6.2 Conclusive Records: DGO's system audit logs, timestamped authorization records, and watch-time telemetry serve as final conclusive evidence of subscription activation and viewing activity.

sections.title: 7. SUBSCRIBER CHECKOUT ACKNOWLEDGEMENT:
sections.body: "[  ] I have read and agree to the DGO International Subscription Terms & Conditions. I explicitly acknowledge and agree that all purchases made outside Nepal are STRICTLY NON-REFUNDABLE under any circumstances, and that no cash refunds, cancellations, or exchanges will be granted once payment is completed."

nepal.title: Subscription Terms & Conditions (Nepal)
nepal.preamble: By completing a subscription payment on DGO (app/web), you agree to be bound by these Subscription Terms &  Conditions. Please read them carefully before making a purchase.

sections.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms & Subscription Purchases
sections.body: 1.1 Purchase Confirmation: All subscription purchases made on DGO are final upon payment confirmation. Subscribers are responsible for verifying package, duration, price, and device compatibility prior to payment through payment partners (eSewa , Khalti, Fonepay, bank transfer). 1.2 Instant Access: Subscription access begins immediately upon successful payment verification by DGO's payment gateway.

sections.title: 2. Refund Eligibility & Rules
sections.body: 2.1 Non-Refundable Nature: Because streaming content is accessible immediately upon purchase, subscriptions are generally non-refundable. Cash refunds for 'double payment' or 'wrong package' will strictly be considered ONLY if ALL mandatory conditions are met: • 24-Hour Reporting Window: Must be formally submitted to DGO Support within 24 hours of the transaction timestamp. • 12-Hour New Plan Purchase: Upgraded plan must be purchased using same User ID within 12 hours of reporting and acknowledgement by Support. • Identity & Payment Match: Transaction details (ID, payment ref, email, phone) must match DGO records and gateway logs. • One-Time Allowance: Accidental purchase refund requests are limited to a maximum of ONE approved request per user account per calendar year.

sections.title: 3. Non-Refundable Scenarios & Buyer Responsibilities
sections.body: • Expired Window: Refund request submitted after 24 hours from the transaction time. • Failure to Purchase Upgraded Plan: Failure to purchase the upgraded plan within 12 hours of submitting the report to DGO Support. • Buyer's Remorse: Changing mind, no longer wishing to watch, or selecting an incompatible package/device. • External Technical Issues: Disruptions caused by user network failure, ISP connection issues, or device incompatibility.

sections.title: 4. Processing Fees & Gateway Deductions
sections.body: 4.1 Gateway Fee Deduction: Where an exceptional cash refund is approved by DGO Finance, payment gateway processing fees (charged by third-party gateways like eSewa, Khalti, Fonepay) are non-refundable. Final refund equals original purchase price minus gateway charges. 4.2 Refund Processing Time: Approved refunds will be processed back to original payment method within 5 to 7 business days, subject to payment provider timelines.

sections.title: 5. Service Disruptions & System Downtime
sections.body: 5.1 Platform Faults: In the event of prolonged service failure solely attributable to DGO platforms lasting continuously over 48 hours, affected users may request a prorated subscription time extension or partial credit at DGO's sole discretion.

sections.title: 6. Contact & Dispute Resolution
sections.body: 6.1 Support Contact: To request support or submit a refund inquiry, users must contact DGO Support through official in-app support chat or email at support@watchdgo.com within 24 hours of purchase, providing registered phone/email and transaction ID. 6.2 Log Verification: All platform system logs, watch-time data, and payment gateway settlement records maintained by DGO shall serve as final and conclusive evidence regarding subscription activity and refund eligibility.

sections.title: 7. SUBSCRIBER CHECKOUT ACKNOWLEDGEMENT:
sections.body: "[  ] I have read and agree to the DGO Subscription Terms & Conditions. I acknowledge that subscriptions are generally non-refundable, and wrong package refunds are only valid within 24 hours, subject to the refund eligibility rules above."

nepal.acknowledgement: I have read and agree to the DGO Subscription Terms & Conditions. I acknowledge that subscriptions are generally non-refundable, and wrong package refunds are only valid within 24 hours, subject to the refund eligibility rules above.
